headline: Supreme Holdings board approves related party transaction
hook: Shareholder vote sought for related party deal
summary: Supreme Holdings & Hospitality (India) Limited held a board meeting on October 28, 2026. The board approved a related party transaction, which now requires shareholder approval via postal ballot. The company has also finalized the draft notice for the postal ballot and appointed a scrutinizer to oversee the process.
whats_next: Postal ballot voting process to follow
why_it_matters: Shareholders must vote on the proposed related party transaction.
